context: The capture has 67 valid URLs: 46 en (including 5 under /en/archive/), 13 de, 7 fr-FR and one /contact with no language. Two sitemaps failed: sitemap-es.xml (HTTP 404) and sitemap-fr.xml.gz (timeout). Judge urls.txt and answer.md.

checklist.name: next_step
